rows.title: Snapshot carries a quest stage
rows.proves: a snapshot of the host makes the guest equal (written against the CoopBackend trait; the engine backend must pass the same row)

rows.title: Delta carries a change
rows.proves: applying a delta makes the guest equal (written against the CoopBackend trait; the engine backend must pass the same row)

rows.title: Snapshot is idempotent
rows.proves: a second identical snapshot changes nothing (written against the CoopBackend trait; the engine backend must pass the same row)

rows.title: Guest runs no quest script
rows.proves: SetStage on a guest is refused (written against the CoopBackend trait; the engine backend must pass the same row)

rows.title: Per-player rows stay private
rows.proves: player 1's quest does not move player 2's or the shared row (written against the CoopBackend trait; the engine backend must pass the same row)

rows.title: Per-player rows reach the guest
rows.proves: shadow rows replicate (written against the CoopBackend trait; the engine backend must pass the same row)

rows.title: Globals replicate
rows.proves: a changed global reaches the guest (written against the CoopBackend trait; the engine backend must pass the same row)

rows.title: EngineBackend reports every row PENDING
rows.proves: run with --backend engine: world-bound rows are PENDING (engine backend)
